prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless square 1024 by 1024 wall texture tile for an original early-1990s first-person shooter game, used directly as the diffuse map of a flat wall mesh.
Create the texture itself filling the entire image edge to edge. Flat straight-on orthographic 2D elevation, uniform material view, zero perspective. It must repeat seamlessly in BOTH horizontal and vertical axes: continue matching panel shapes, colors and wear across opposite image edges, no outer frame or border.
Style: deliberate 1993 PC game pixel art, chunky crisp pixel clusters, restrained dithering, visibly rough low-resolution materials, limited earthy palette. Small industrial panel seams and bolts, medium-value readable surfaces rather than near-black areas. Completely even diffuse lighting with no directional illumination, no shadows cast into space, no gradients imitating a room, no vignette, no wide black gaps.
Subject: olive-green industrial riveted steel for an entry sector. Broad olive and dusty khaki rectangular steel panels, small recessed fasteners, chipped grey metal edges and restrained scuffs. A modest desaturated yellow-and-charcoal diagonal hazard-stripe inset runs horizontally across the lower quarter of the tile; keep most of the image useful olive metal, with the stripe thin enough to remain a secondary detail. Panel seams are narrow and medium-dark, never thick black outlines. Worn original painted metal, visually simple and legible at a distance. Palette: warm olive, grey-green, dusty khaki, muted ochre yellow, small charcoal details.
Constraints: opaque surface texture only. No room, corridor, environment render, vanishing point, angled surface, 3D perspective, floor, ceiling, depth scene, characters, weapons, text, letters, symbols, numbers, signage, logos, watermark, border, modern neon, cyberpunk glow or glossy photoreal materials. Do not present multiple material swatches or an asset sheet. One repeatable tile.
post_processing: Native square PNG converted to 1024×1024 WebP using cwebp -q 85 -m 6 -resize 1024 1024; no crop or painting. Exact prompt recorded with Impeccable embed-prompt using its WebP sidecar fallback.
